newsitem.title: THAILAND: Italian-Thai slows work on second airport.
newsitem.headline: Italian-Thai slows work on second airport.

text.p: Thailand's largest construction firm Italian-Thai Development Plc said on Wednesday it had scaled down work on the possible site of Bangkok's second international airport.

In a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, the company said New Bangkok International Airport Co Ltd, which is overseeing development of the site, had instructed the company to slow down land infill works on the Nong Ngu Hao project east of the Thai capital.
In December 1996 Italian-Thai won an 11.65 billion baht ($448 million) contract to begin land infill on the site.

The Thai cabinet has postponed development of the second airport at Nong Ngu Hao in the eastern outskirts of Bangkok. It has instead decided to first expand existing facilities at Bangkok's Don Muang International Airport.
